ui_qualification.review: Controls and text are readable in landscape at the Pixel profile. The 640x288 render is visibly coarse, and the frozen Info capture reports 0 host frames/s even after a complete timing window; ordinary performance comes from the separate FrameWindow report.

validation: The APK was built and installed from the clean tested commit before qualification.
All reports pin the tested revision and the APK or input-report hashes.
The UI and performance runners pin their own exact script hashes.
The performance runner samples Android thermal service after every scene and requires status 0.
Tracked logs contain no private device serial.
limitations: The pixel-7-preview profile remains unverified for performance: all 28 scenes stayed below 30 FPS, and the slowest scene reached 1.66 FPS.
The low-resolution renderer is visibly coarse. Increasing render resolution is not justified until physics frame work improves.
The common Info view's host-rate field reads 0 while the debug UI is frozen; use performance.json for measured ordinary-presentation rates.
Thermal status stayed clear over this bounded sweep; this is not an hours-long battery endurance claim.
